findings.title: Bulk CSV export of full member roster
findings.description: Customer's coordinator manually paged through the member list and copied it into a spreadsheet chunk by chunk, taking most of a morning last quarter. Customer asked for a one-click export button covering the full roster, all fields, as CSV, for an annual training audit. This capability shipped in release 4.3 (2026-06-10) as the 'Export all (CSV)' button on Admin panel > Members, which the customer confirmed exists when shown.
findings.quote: I need to get the full member roster out of the system. Everyone, all fields, one file — for our annual training audit.
findings.severity_reason: Feature already shipped and confirmed working for the customer; only remaining action is a how-to email, not a product fix.
findings.match_note: Directly matches PROJ-095 (bulk CSV roster export), shipped in 4.3 on 2026-06-10; customer confirmed the button is present.

findings.title: No webhook event emitted on session completion (member ID + timestamp) for LMS integration
findings.description: Customer's LMS (Cornerstone) is the system of record for all training/safety compliance required by auditors, OSHA, and corporate. Currently, participation data is exported and manually hand-keyed into Cornerstone monthly by the customer's team, which is described as tedious and error-prone for a compliance record. The customer's integrations contact requested that BetterBark send a session-completed webhook carrying the member ID and completion timestamp so Cornerstone can automatically record participation. CSM was unsure whether such an event already exists and planned to confirm before filing.
findings.quote: Ask if they can send a session-completed webhook with the member ID and timestamp; we'll do the rest.
findings.severity_reason: Feeds an audit/OSHA compliance system of record; manual entry is error-prone and an error in this data is described as a potential audit finding, with no automated workaround today.
findings.match_note: Distinct from PROJ-087 (duplicate webhook deliveries to existing endpoints); this is a request for a new session-completed event type that does not currently exist, not a fix to duplicate delivery of an existing webhook.
